Independent check-only sequential actual16..19 join
==================================================
V2 REPAIR: the supplied actual15 snapshot is provenance, not proof of its
own closure flags. base_replay.py freshly calls the unchanged actual15
check-only routines, reconstructing every selected native receipt, original
100-panel disposition, outward interface,16-root forest and Fourier cover.
Only that freshly derived boolean licenses the actual16 predecessor. A
supplied snapshot that CLAIMS closure must exactly match the newly derived
summary and full source graph. The known incomplete SNAPSHOT01 is mutated
to claim closure, empty pending and both100-panel flags; this must reject.
The executed v1 remains preserved. V1 partial conclusions remain false and
valid; this repair prevents future promotion from tampered public flags.
The fresh base readback is saved as a separate immutable ACTUAL15_BASE_...
file under this v2 epoch. It repeats no native arithmetic or integration.

This is a separate scoped readback; the actual15 checker is preserved.
No mathematical evaluator is imported, no count leaf is recomputed, and no
Fourier integral is repeated. Native fresh semantic replays remain the
arithmetic evidence. This checker independently reconstructs their precise
scopes, predecessor dependencies, original100-panel covers, outward
resource/count interfaces, and every original n+1-root closed forest.

Retained analytic A and base requirement
--------------------------------------
The retained A is exactly the unrestricted attained-witness/contact,
signed moment/LOW/physical-gap resource and count reduction listed in
audit/actual15_join_v1/PROOF.txt. Published Fourier inputs remain separate.
A selected actual15 join snapshot is an explicit provenance input. Unless
fresh unchanged actual15 check-only semantics derive complete closure, no
n16 predecessor edge is licensed. A stale partial input can be superseded
only by that separately saved fresh base replay, never by flipping its flags.
It is invalid to replace this GLOBAL sharp predecessor by a pointwise cap
only for a few inherited laws or by a successful finite-n resource label.

Literal conditional implication at n in16,...,19
------------------------------------------------
Assume the GLOBAL all-threshold C_(n-1)<=C_E for every standardized iid
law. If an unrestricted positive sharp-contrary maximizing witness exists
at actual n, its score is at least C_E. Therefore

  n(C_(n-1)(P)-C_n(P))_+ =0.

This licenses q=0 in the contact support proof for that SAME marginal P.
The complete direct-Gaussian support rays are computed at the literal n,
before any gap/INITIAL assumption. The selected two-ray supports have
radius2.3 for B0 and2.4 for BN, except BN n19 already has radius2.3.
They imply support<=3. The full supported Fourier theorem at actual n
therefore licenses the own cap .417 for rho[1,1.1] or .4135 for[1.1,1.15].
No comparison of maximizing laws at different n, monotonicity of C_n, or
constrained extremality is used. The Fourier owncap cannot be applied
before support; the q0 support proof itself does not require that owncap.

Each literal supported compensated HIGH table row independently gives
H_n<=.382 or.409; its radius3 and rho premises hold before INITIAL. The
selected INITIAL starts raw=D=None, has eight complete signed feedback
covers and a ninth complete export. It acquires physical D<sqrt(10)-1.
Its full semantic replay is required. No refuted moment-only D seed enters.

For each band at each n, resources reconstruct the100 original closed p
panels. Every successful exclusion or acquisition is freshly replayed.
All acquisitions use the actual q0, cap, radius and literal n. Source ports
preserve every gate and the count n>=2 mathematics (see count15_range_v1).
Count conversion preserves original physical shared-budget Lambda and uses
only an equal redundant independent cap. Positive physical endpoint floors,
signed beta, physical mean and signed whole-H envelopes belong to P.

The original root contains p,lambda in[0,Lambda],alpha in[0,1],phase in
[-1/2,1/2],a0 in[0,d0]. Nearest-count gates cover all k=0,...,n. Every
closed split has both children; every leaf is reconstructed and native
acceptance has recomputed its full arithmetic. Strict score comparisons
use the same rational CE lower bound. Missing/failing panels are pending,
never exclusions. Thus a complete low-rho family excludes the contrary
witness in that band, conditional on the GLOBAL predecessor.

Higher-rho coverage and sequencing
---------------------------------
For rho in[1.15,1.32], the existing coarse radius3 support bridge at each
literal n applies using the independent auxiliary C_(n-1)<.42 theorem
(actual15..18 rows), or the stronger sequential sharp predecessor. The
supported Fourier actual n BH row gives score<.4097<CE. For rho>=1.32,
the unrestricted actual n high-rho Fourier theorem supplies the same
strict bound, with its full published infinite rho tail. Both signs and
atoms are inherited from the all-threshold Fourier inequality or from
whole-law reflection in A. All these sources are already constituents of
the selected full actual15 join, whose Fourier covers include14,...,19;
the present checker separately requires those exact n scopes in that graph.

After every original panel and Fourier edge at n is complete, the result
is the conditional implication (A and global sharp n-1) => global sharp n.
The checker carries a boolean predecessor-established flag in increasing
order15->16->17->18->19. An unclosed n leaves every subsequent sequential
conclusion unestablished even if its conditional arithmetic is complete.
This is proof composition, not a numerical monotonicity claim.

The imported eventual20+ theorem is kept as a separately named RETAINED
conditional edge. The supplied final composition/readback and this
session's import audit are bound as evidence; the present checker does not
freshly reconstruct its entire historical analytic/arithmetic dependency
DAG. Missing recorded historical inputs and inherited framework obligations
remain recorded in audit/REVIEW.txt and IMPORT_CHECKED.json. A final cutoff15
conclusion may be described only conditional on A, the Fourier analytic
inputs, and that retained eventual20+ edge. It is not an unqualified proof
of the conjecture or a fresh independent reproof of the20+ continuation.

Execution and negative controls
-------------------------------
common.py contains copied readback utilities from the already reviewed
actual15 checker and parameterized interface/geometry functions. It imports
no native mathematical module. Parameter n is validated explicitly as an
integer16..19; root cardinality and full-binary identity use n+1. The
shared original source and complete port are bound in SOURCE_COPY.json.
Every written snapshot is immutable and names its actual15 input explicitly.
Native source manifests, result hashes, captures and complete inventories
are checked. The checker also exercises malformed global predecessor
flags, skipped n, malformed roots, and altered original Lambda using
disposable copies. The independent actual15 geometry controls remain a
separate bound receipt; they are not counted as new n16..19 leaf replays.

If resources or counts are still running, the output records exact pending
paths and separate mathematical conditional/execution status. It never
infers a completed sequential result from an absent file or native false
premise flag. Even complete conditional composition retains explicit A and
retained20+ dependencies; unqualified_cutoff15_proved remains false.
